mapper.select: select volume_id, tongjian_id, title, ji, sort_order from tj_volume order by sort_order
select reign_id, tongjian_id, volume_id, emperor_name, reign_name, year_anno, year_int, sort_order, synced from tj_reign order by sort_order

select r.reign_id, r.tongjian_id, r.volume_id, r.emperor_name, r.reign_name, r.year_anno, r.year_int, r.sort_order, r.synced, v.title as volume_title, v.ji as ji from tj_reign r left join tj_volume v on v.volume_id = r.volume_id where r.reign_id = #{reignId}
select volume_id, tongjian_id, title, ji, sort_order from tj_volume where tongjian_id = #{tongjianId}
select reign_id, tongjian_id, volume_id, emperor_name, reign_name, year_anno, year_int, sort_order, synced from tj_reign where tongjian_id = #{tongjianId}
mapper.insert: insert into tj_volume (tongjian_id, title, ji, sort_order) values (#{tongjianId}, #{title}, #{ji}, #{sortOrder})

insert into tj_reign (tongjian_id, volume_id, emperor_name, reign_name, year_anno, year_int, sort_order, synced) values (#{tongjianId}, #{volumeId}, #{emperorName}, #{reignName}, #{yearAnno}, #{yearInt}, #{sortOrder}, '0')
mapper.update: update tj_reign set synced = '1' where reign_id = #{reignId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from tj_reign where synced = '1'
